programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: This new adaptation of the most powerful martial arts form is a cult classic for all fans. Witness breathtaking special effects.

programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers' quintessential 'Huangmei Opera' costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: Brave Archer and His Mate

programme.title: Oath of Death

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: A righteous man who can't fight and an unjustly wronged swordsman team up to battle against evil.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: An ace swordsman fights evil, rescues women and takes part in duels to the death.

programme.title: The Bride Napping

programme.title: Killers on Wheels
